page.overview:
Who is Dhṛtarāṣṭra?

When Sun Wukong went up to Heaven to call down rain for Phoenix Immortal Prefecture, Dhṛtarāṣṭra informed him that rain was banned in the region.

A little while later, Dhṛtarāṣṭra prevented the Jade Rabbit Spirit from fleeing up to Heaven on Sun Wukong's orders.
